name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=audio, descriptor=bgm_driver_available_flag. Accurately reflects purpose (MDI/BGM driver installed boolean) and data type (flag). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Boolean flag set to 1 when the Miles MDI (BGM) driver installs successfully at startup; gates all BGM track load/playback.
logic_summary: Default 0 (BSS). main() sets it to 1 once at startup, only inside the AIL_install_MDI_INI()!=NULL branch (right after storing data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_handle and allocating data_fd2_audio_bgm_sequence_handle). fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade tests it as a gate: if non-zero it proceeds to stop/load/init/start the requested FDMUS.DAT sequence; if zero, BGM track switching is a silent no-op.
element_semantics: Single byte used as a boolean: 0 = MDI BGM driver not installed (no BGM), 1 = installed (BGM enabled). All accesses are byte-width (MOV byte / CMP byte), consistent with the undefined1/byte size hint.
notes: 1 writer (main @ 0x25C16), 1 reader (fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade @ 0x259BA). Verified via disasm: writer MOV byte ptr [0x53EF0],0x1; reader CMP byte ptr [0x53EF0],0. Memory all zeros (BSS). DT=undefined1 len=1. Ghidra plate was empty (<null>); created a concise plate per src conclusion. src comment block (main.c lines 935-953) already accurate and precise -- not modified.
